about: Manual overrides for scripts/build-universe.mjs. ids: CoinGecko coin to use for an exchange symbol when the largest-market-cap coin with that symbol is a different asset. keep: coins that a CoinGecko stablecoin/security category would drop but that are not themselves stablecoins or securities. exclude: coins to drop that no category catches.

FRAX.reason: Binance and Bithumb FRAX is the Frax governance token (formerly FXS, about $0.29), not the Legacy Frax Dollar stablecoin that shares the symbol

keep.EL: ELYSIA is the governance and staking token of a real-estate tokenization platform; it is not a share in any property (CoinGecko lists it under Tokenized Real Estate for the platform)
